## Make plots with overview of found snippets - per sphere

```{r}
get_data_sites_na <- function(sphere_, translate_domains){
  # if(sphere_ == "German"){
  #   gs_domain_to_look <- read_delim(file = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/",sphere_,"/gs_domain_to_look.csv"))
  # }else{
  #   load(file = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/",sphere_,"/gs_domain_to_look.RData"))
  # }
  
  db_sites <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.crawl_date, t.site, t.sphere FROM sites t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(year = year(crawl_date)) %>%
    reframe(counted_site = n(), .by = c(year, site))
    
  year <- df_timespan_year %>% mutate(year = year(value)) %>% select(year) %>% pull(.)
  
  site <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.site FROM sites t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>%
          pull(site)
  df_na_sites <- tidyr::expand_grid(year, site) %>% 
    left_join(., db_sites) %>% 
    filter(is.na(counted_site)) %>% 
    mutate(counted_sites = "no sites archived") %>% 
    left_join(., translate_domains, by = "site")
    
  return(df_na_sites)
}

get_sites_counted <- function(sphere_){
        db_sites <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.crawl_date, t.site, t.sha1 FROM sites t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
          mutate(year = year(crawl_date)) %>% 
          reframe(counted_sites = n(), .by = c(year, site)) 
        
        return(db_sites)
}

```

### Funktion für annotierte Daten pro Sphere

```{r}

get_annotated_data <- function(sphere_){
  annotated_data <- read_csv(paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/", SPREADSHEET_ANNOTATION[[{sphere_}]]), show_col_types = FALSE)
        annotation_is_empty <- annotated_data %>% nrow() == 0
        # check_gs_empty(annotated_data)
        if(!annotation_is_empty) {
          gs_annotation <- annotated_data %>%
            mutate(type = "manual",
                   date = paste0(year, "-", ifelse(is.na(month), "1", month), "-", ifelse(is.na(day), "1", day)) %>% ymd(.),
                   technology = ifelse(is.na(technology), "other", technology))
        } else {
          gs_annotation <- annotated_data %>%
            mutate(type = "manual",
                   technology = ifelse(is.na(technology), "other", technology))
        }
        return(gs_annotation)
      }

```


```{r}

## copied from shiny app

get_traces_found <- function(sphere_, translate_domains){
  db_traces_findings <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.crawl_date, t.site, tr.trace, tr.search_type, t.sphere FROM sites t INNER JOIN traces tr ON t.sha1 = tr.site WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
          mutate(year = year(crawl_date)) %>% #View()
          select(-crawl_date) %>% 
          distinct() %>% 
          left_join(., retranslate_snippets, by = c("trace" = "snippet")) %>% 
          select(-trace) %>% 
          distinct() %>% 
          group_by(year, site) %>% ## these lines until the end needed for building the aes for plotting
          mutate(
            nr_systems_per_site = row_number() %>% max(.),
            duplicated = ifelse(is.na(system) & nr_systems_per_site > 1, "duplicated", NA)) %>% #View()
          filter(is.na(duplicated)) %>%
          mutate(
            nr_systems_per_site = row_number(),
            year_printing = paste0(year, ".", nr_systems_per_site) %>% as.numeric(),
            type = "automated",
            system = if_else(is.na(system), "generic", system)) %>% #View()
          ungroup() %>% 
          left_join(., translate_domains)
}

plot_traces_found <- function(sphere_, translate_domains){
  
  db_traces_findings <- get_traces_found(sphere_, translate_domains)
  # db_traces_findings <- get_traces_found(sphere_, gs_domain_to_look)
  
  systems_found <- db_traces_findings %>% select(system) %>% distinct() %>% pull(.)
  color_values <- df_systems_color_legend %>% filter(system %in% systems_found) %>% deframe()
        
  df_sites_na <- get_data_sites_na(sphere_, translate_domains)
  # df_sites_na <- get_data_sites_na(sphere_, gs_domain_to_look)
  df_annotated <- get_annotated_data(sphere_) |> filter(!is.na(site))
        
  plot_snippets <- ggplot() +
          geom_tile(data = df_sites_na, aes(x = year, y = Name), fill = "grey90") +
          geom_point_interactive(data = db_traces_findings, aes(x = year_printing, y = Name, fill = system, shape = type, tooltip = paste0("site: ", site, "\nyear: ", year, "\nsystem: ", system)), width = .2, height = 0, na.rm = TRUE, size = 5, color = "black", alpha = .8) +
          geom_point_interactive(data = df_annotated, aes(x = year, y = Name, fill = technology, tooltip = paste0("site: ", site, "\nyear: ", year, "\ncomment: ", tooltip_info, "\nsystem: ", technology), shape = type), size = 5, color = "black", alpha = .8, position = position_nudge(x = -.3)) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = color_values, na.value = NA, name = "type of system") +
          scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23), breaks = c("automated", "manual"), name = "type of observation")+
          scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks_for_plotting, labels = year_breaks_for_plotting,  expand = c(0, NA), name = "crawl year") +#, limits = year_breaks) +
          theme_b03_base + theme_b03_base_typo_static + theme_b03_dot_timeline +  
          coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
          guides(
            fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", override.aes = list(shape = 22)),
            shape = guide_legend(title.position = "top", override.aes = list(color = "black"))
          )
        
    ggsave(filename = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/", sphere_, "/overview-traces-found.png"), width = 15, height = 12)#, dpi = 144)
        # girafe(ggobj = plot_snippets, options = list(opts_sizing(rescale = FALSE)),
        #        width_svg = 15,
        #        height_svg = 10
        # )
}

sphere_ <- "German"
gs_domain_to_look <- read_delim(file = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/",sphere_,"/gs_domain_to_look.csv"))
plot_traces_found(sphere_, gs_domain_to_look)

sphere_ <- "World"
load(file = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/",sphere_,"/gs_domain_to_look.RData"))
# clipr::write_clip(gs_domain_to_look)
plot_traces_found(sphere_, gs_domain_to_look)

sphere_ <- "Dutch"
```

```{r}
plot_sites_archived <- function(sphere_, translate_domains){
  # clipr::write_clip(gs_domain_to_look)
  
  df_sites_archived <- get_sites_counted(sphere_)
  df_traces_found <- get_traces_found(sphere_, gs_domain_to_look) %>% select(site) %>% distinct()
  
  df_sites_archived %>% 
          mutate(system_detected = ifelse(site %in% df_traces_found$site, "system found", "no system found")) %>% 
          left_join(., translate_domains, by = "site") %>% #View()
          ggplot(aes(x = year, y = Name, fill = counted_sites)) +
          geom_tile_interactive(aes(tooltip = paste0("year: ", year, "\nsite: ", site, "\nsites_counted: ", counted_sites))) +
          scale_fill_gradientn(colors = met.brewer("Hokusai2", type="continuous"), na.value = "grey90", name = "number of websites available" ) +
          scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks_for_plotting, expand = c(0, NA), name = "crawl_year") +
          scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, NA), limits = rev(df_sites_archived$Name)) +
          ggforce::facet_col(facets = vars(system_detected), scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
          guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", barwidth = unit(20, "lines"), barheight = unit(.5, "lines"))) +
          theme_b03_base + theme_b03_base_typo_static + theme_b03_heatmap + theme_b03_facets  + theme_b03_legend_discrete
  
   ggsave(filename = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/", sphere_, "/histogram-archived-sites.png"), width = 15, height = 12)
}

gs_domain_to_look <- read_delim(file = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/",sphere_,"/gs_domain_to_look.csv"))
```

```{r}

get_height <- function(nr_){
   # nr_systems <- as.numeric(nr_ %>% select(system) %>% distinct() %>% nrow())
# facethöhe: hier fließt die überschrift und die x-achse als entscheidende größen ein. x-achse gibts für alle facets nur einmal
  minheight_one_facet = 1
  # jede datenreihe braucht ein bisschen platz, aber keine neue überschrift
  minheight_one_row = 0.3
  
  sum_height <- minheight_one_facet + minheight_one_row + (minheight_one_row * nr_)
  # print(sum_height)
  
  return(sum_height)
}

load(paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/systems/df_system_lifetime.RData"))

get_systems_found <- function(sphere_){
  db_systems_counted <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.crawl_date, t.site, tr.trace, t.sphere FROM sites t INNER JOIN traces tr ON t.sha1 = tr.site WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"'AND tr.search_type ='snippet_list' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(year = year(crawl_date)) %>% 
    select(year, trace, site) %>% 
    left_join(., retranslate_snippets, by = c("trace" = "snippet")) %>% 
    select(year, system, site) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    reframe(counted_domains = n(), .by = c(year, system)) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(system))
}

plot_systems_found <- function(sphere_){
  df_counted_systems <- get_systems_found(sphere_)
  current_systems_found <- df_counted_systems %>% select(system) %>% distinct() %>% pull(.)
          
  df_system_lifetime_filtered <- df_system_lifetime %>% 
    filter(name %in% current_systems_found) %>% #View()
    reframe(counted_years = sum(present, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(name, check_years)) %>%   
    mutate(counted_years = ifelse(counted_years == 1, as.character(counted_years), NA))
    
  ggplot() +
      geom_tile(data = df_system_lifetime_filtered, aes(x = check_years, y = name, color = counted_years), fill = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "darkgreen"), na.value = NA) + 
      geom_tile(data = df_counted_systems, aes(x = year, y = system, fill = counted_domains)) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colors = met.brewer("Hokusai2", type="continuous"), na.value = "grey90", name = "number of websites with system" ) +
      theme_b03_base + theme_b03_base_typo_static + theme_b03_heatmap +
      guides(color = "none",
             fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", barwidth = unit(20, "lines"), barheight = unit(.5, "lines")))
    
  heigth_ <- get_height(length(current_systems_found))
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/", sphere_, "/overview-systems-found.png"), width = 15, height = heigth_)#, dpi = 144)
}

gs_domain_to_look <- read_delim(file = paste0("../../../3_visualizing_app/technograph/data/",sphere_,"/gs_domain_to_look.csv"))
```

### Funktion für annotierte Daten abrufen pro Domain

```{r}

get_gs_annoted_data_spez <- function(sphere_, site_){

  gs_annotation_raw <- get_annotated_data("German") %>% filter(site == site_) #%>% View()
  
  annotation_is_empty <- gs_annotation_raw %>% nrow() == 0
  
  if(annotation_is_empty > 0) {
    gs_annotation <- gs_annotation_raw %>% 
      filter(site == site_, tooltip_info != "") %>% 
      mutate(facet_ = "manual research",
             date = paste0(year, "-", ifelse(is.na(month), "1", month), "-", ifelse(is.na(day), "1", day)) %>% ymd(.),
             # technology = ifelse(is.na(technology), "other", technology),
             shape_color = 9999999,
             shape_fill = NA,
             shape_nr = 19
             ) %>% 
      rename("crawl_date" = "date", "site_subdomain" = "Name") %>% 
      select(crawl_date, site_subdomain, type, shape_color, shape_fill, shape_nr, tooltip_info)
  }
  else{
    gs_annotation <- gs_annotation_raw %>% 
      mutate(facet_ = "manual research",
             date = NA_Date_,
             Name = NA_character_,
             tooltip_info = NA_character_,
             shape_color = NA,
             shape_fill = NA,
             shape_nr = NA) %>% 
      rename("crawl_date" = "date", "site_subdomain" = "Name") %>% 
      select(crawl_date, site_subdomain, type, shape_color, shape_fill, shape_nr, tooltip_info) 
  }
  return(gs_annotation)
  }
```

```{r}
get_traces_found_subdomain <-  function(sphere_, site_) {
  # get_traces_found <- function(sphere_){
  db_traces_findings <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.crawl_date, t.site, tr.trace, tr.search_type, t.url, t.sphere FROM sites t INNER JOIN traces tr ON t.sha1 = tr.site WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.site = '", site_, "'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
  # filter(site == "abendblatt") %>% 
          mutate(year = year(crawl_date),
                 subdomain = urltools::domain(url) %>% suffix_extract(.) %>% select(subdomain) %>% pull(.),
                 site_subdomain = paste(site, subdomain, sep = "_") %>% as.character(.)) %>% #View()
          select(-crawl_date,-url) %>% 
          distinct() %>% 
          left_join(., retranslate_snippets, by = c("trace" = "snippet")) %>% 
          select(-trace) %>% 
          distinct() %>% 
          group_by(year, site, site_subdomain) %>% ## these lines until the end needed for building the aes for plotting
          mutate(
            nr_systems_per_site = row_number() %>% max(.),
            duplicated = ifelse(is.na(system) & nr_systems_per_site > 1, "duplicated", NA)) %>% #View()
          # filter(is.na(duplicated)) %>%
          mutate(
            nr_systems_per_site = row_number(),
            year_printing = paste0(year, ".", nr_systems_per_site) %>% as.numeric(),
            type = "automated",
            system = if_else(is.na(system), "generic", system)) %>% #View()
          ungroup() %>% 
          left_join(., gs_domain_to_look) %>% 
  mutate(facet_ = if_else(search_type == "snippet_list", "traces via snippet detection", "traces via generic detection"))
}
```

```{r}
exclude_side_subdomain <- read.csv("../../../data/helper/exclude-side-subdomain.csv", header = FALSE) %>% pull(.) #%>%  paste(., collapse=("|"))
sub_traces <- sub_traces %>% pull(.) %>% paste(., collapse=("|"))

snippets_to_find <- read.csv("../../../data/helper/24-07-12-Commenting-system-detection-patterns.csv", sep = ";")
str_snippets_to_find <- snippets_to_find %>% select(regex) %>% pull(.) %>% paste(collapse = "|")

get_data_snippets_traces_ <- function(search_in, sphere_){
  df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.sphere, t.tag, t.",search_in," as raw_trace FROM traces_context t WHERE t.sphere = '", sphere_,"' AND t.",search_in," ~* '", str_snippets_to_find, "'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% #View()
    mutate(trace = str_extract(raw_trace, regex(str_snippets_to_find, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% 
  # select(-column_t) %>% 
  mutate(search_type = "snippet_list",
         comment = search_in) 
}

df_sites <- function(sphere_){
  df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.crawl_date, t.site, t.url, t.sphere FROM sites t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.of_interest = TRUE"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(subdomain = urltools::domain(url) %>% suffix_extract(.) %>% select(subdomain) %>% pull(.),
           site_subdomain = paste(site, subdomain, sep = "_") %>% as.character(.))
}

get_data_comment_traces <- function(sphere_){
  df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.sphere, t.id_date_site_subdomain FROM traces_context t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' "), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(simple_date = str_extract(id_date_site_subdomain, "^\\d{4,4}-\\d{1,2}-01") %>% as_date(.),
         site_subdomain = str_remove(id_date_site_subdomain, "^\\d{4,4}-\\d{1,2}-01_")) %>%
  reframe(counted_comments = n(), .by = c(site_subdomain, simple_date))
}

get_data_sub_traces <- function(sphere_, search_in){
  df <- dbGetQuery(conn = con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT t.sha1, t.tag, t.sphere, t.",search_in," as raw_trace FROM traces_context t WHERE t.sphere ='", sphere_,"' AND t.",search_in," ~* '", sub_traces, "'"), check_interrupts = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(trace = str_extract(raw_trace, regex(sub_traces, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  # select(-column_t) 
  mutate(search_type = "sub_traces",
         comment = search_in) 
}
```

```{r}
  reframe(counted = n(), .by = c(site_subdomain, simple_date, trace, search_type)) %>%

just_traces <- df_script_sub_traces_traces %>%

found_traces <- just_traces %>% select(trace) %>% distinct()# %>% pull(.)

  reframe(sum_comments = sum(counted_comments), .by = simple_date)

  left_join(., df_comment_traces_)

  as_tibble() %>% 
  rename(simple_date = value) %>% 
  expand_grid(., found_traces) %>% # View()

  left_join(., just_traces) %>% 
  mutate(is_set = ifelse(!is.na(counted_traces), 1, NA)) %>% 
  group_by(trace) %>% 
  fill(is_set, .direction = "updown") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(is_set == 1)#%>% 
  # filter(!site_subdomain %in% exclude_side_subdomain)

shape_search_type <- c("snippet_list"= 18, "sub_traces" = 19)

ggplot() +

  geom_point(data = df_meta_info, aes(x = simple_date, y = trace, size = sum_comments), color = "#31eccd", shape = 15) +
  geom_point(data = just_traces, aes(x = simple_date, y = trace, size = counted_traces), color = "black") +
  # facet_col(vars(site_subdomain), scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", date_breaks = "2 years", limits = c(as.Date("1998-01-01"), as.Date("2021-09-01")), expand = c(0,NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_search_type) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_search_type) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = met.brewer("Hokusai2", type="continuous"), na.value = "grey90") +
    theme_b03_base +theme_b03_base_typo_static + theme_b03_heatmap + theme_b03_facets + theme_b03_legend_discrete + theme_b03_panel_spacing +
    theme_b03_timeline_faceted +  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey70", linewidth = .2))
```

## Grafik: Funktionalitäten innerhalb von Kommentaroptionen



Auf der x-Achse zeigt die Grafik einen Zeitverlauf. Für solche Zeitabschnitte, zu dienen archivierte Webseiten existieren, sind bläulich markiert, je mehr desto blauer. 
Rosafarbene Markierungen zeigen, dass es zu diesem Zeitpunkt Kommentarbereiche extrahiert wurden. Beide Informationen werden unabhängig zur y-Achse gezeichnet.

Die y-Achse zeigt für jede der Nachrichtenseiten die Stichworte, die für die jeweilige Seite gefunden wurden. Diese werden durch die schwarzen Kreise dargestellt. Je größer ein Kreis gezeichnet ist, desto häufiger wurde das Wort gezählt.

::: panel-tabset
